snippet.title: Superhero Simulator – Full Release Trailer | Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
🦸 GET THE GAME ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3531260/Superhero_Simulator/
💬 JOIN OUR OFFICIAL DISCORD:

https://discord.com/invite/HeDPKP5byz

Goldpine City needs a hero. Create yours, take to the skies, stop crimes, rescue civilians, and face powerful villains. Unlock new abilities and rise from rookie to legend.
But superpowers won’t pay your rent. Between saving lives and fighting bad guys, you’ll need to work, eat, and handle the everyday struggles of superhero life.

Join our Discord to meet other players, share feedback, report bugs, and follow the latest updates.

Developed by mightyraccoon! studios.
#SuperheroSimulator #LaunchTrailer #Steam

👍 CONNECT WITH ME!
https://twitter.com/mightyraccoon0
https://twitter.com/sarusaral
https://www.instagram.com/mraccoon/
https://www.facebook.com/saruhansaralanimations

This is not a commercial but a personal project and I'm not affiliated with any company.

🎬  MY OTHER WORKS:

https://youtu.be/rzGdv4cg4Us

- Hello everyone my name is Saruhan Saral. Studying Graphic Design in Istanbul. Huuuuuuuuuuuuuge super hero fan. Hope you enjoy my videos!
